---
name: Feature request / idea
about: Suggest an enhancement
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do that the tool doesn't currently support?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like the tool to do, and roughly how you imagine it working
in the Admin Tools menu or sidebar.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you've thought about solving it (workarounds, manual steps,
other tools).

## Who benefits

Is this useful only to you, or do you think other users would want it?
